statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-50163: the oras-go file store can resolve a hardlink target outside the extraction directory during tar extraction; oras.land/oras-go/v2 is fixed in 2.6.2 (https://github.com/oras-project/oras-go/security/advisories/GHSA-fxhp-mv3v-67qp, https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-5880). The Go build information of /usr/bin/trivy in each of the 37 published trivy-dev builds for Alpine 3.23 (0.69.1-r0 to 0.74.0-r11), on both x86_64 and aarch64, was read for this decision. Builds before 0.71.2-r3 embed oras.land/oras-go/v2 2.6.0 to 2.6.1, which the advisory lists as affected. Builds from 0.71.2-r3 on embed oras.land/oras-go/v2 2.6.2, which the advisory does not list as affected.
